questions.question: Naaman, the respected commander of Aram's army, had one serious problem. What was wrong with him?
After Naaman dipped in the Jordan seven times as Elisha said, what was his flesh like?

answers.text: Like the flesh of a little child
Clean except for one small spot

questions.question: After being healed of leprosy, what did Naaman declare to the prophet Elisha?

answers.text: There is no God in all the earth except in Israel
The waters of Israel are better than any in Aram
Elisha is greater than any king in the world

questions.question: After Elisha's servant Gehazi lied to get silver, whose leprosy did Elisha say would cling to him and his descendants forever?
